message.content:
Is it easier to urbanize a jungle or to urbanize a desert?
Often drylands offer simpler ground preparation because there are few trees to remove.
The central difficulty is water rather than the absence of building material.
Forested lowlands may have rivers but dense root networks slow excavation.
They also carry higher risks from mosquitoes and from habitat disruption.
If water can be secured, arid sites may be planned with broad open corridors.
A giraffe is not the deciding factor in such comparisons.
